p: within the inheritance of the children: According to Jacob's prophecy that he would be scattered among the other tribes.
much for them: But this large portion was given them by God's providence to declare their increase in time to come.
toward the sea: Or, westward, toward the great sea.
Bethlehem: There was another Bethlehem in the tribe of Judah.
Engannim: There was another city of this name in the tribe of Judah: for in various tribes certain cities had the same name, and were distinguished by the tribe only.
Zebulun: Joins to the tribe of Zebulun, which lay more to the east.
Tyre: Which was Zoar, a strong city at the sea.
Heleph: These cities were in the country of Zaanannim.
Chinnereth: Of which the lake of Gennesaret had its name.
fight against Leshem: According as Jacob had prophesied in Ge 49:17.
